how_it_works.section_subtitle: Deterministic matching, transparent price floors, and zero algorithmic wage suppression across all 6 steps.
how_it_works.step_1_desc: Select trade, time slot, and location with transparent standardized hourly tariffs.
how_it_works.step_2_desc: Workers matched by proximity, skill verification, availability, and rotational queue equity.
how_it_works.step_3_desc: Seva Partners accept shifts within their chosen work radius with guaranteed floor wage.
how_it_works.step_4_desc: Live Seva Partner GPS telemetry with cooperative standby replacement dispatch on delay.
how_it_works.step_5_desc: Pay post-service via Razorpay Escrow. 85% goes directly to the actual working Seva Partner.
how_it_works.step_6_desc: Ratings and verified experience accrue to the Seva Partner's sovereign portable KARM ID.

trust.section_title: Trust Built On Public Digital Infrastructure
trust.section_subtitle: Direct cooperative backing, identity and skill vetting, and transparent welfare distributions.
trust.feature_1_desc: Every Seva Partner belongs to a legally registered cooperative union with welfare protections.
trust.feature_2_desc: Verified identity, police verification where required, and skill credentials accessible via instant QR scan.
trust.feature_3_desc: 85% direct to actual Seva Partner, 10% cooperative emergency welfare fund, 5% public DPI upkeep.
trust.feature_4_desc: Instant substitute dispatch by cooperative if primary Seva Partner faces emergency leave.
trust.feature_5_desc: Citizen contact numbers and identity documents are securely masked and tokenized.
trust.feature_6_desc: Dedicated rapid-response Seva Partner squad for urgent electrical, plumbing, or hazard issues.

roles_section.section_subtitle: Specialized, purpose-built interfaces tailored for every stakeholder in the cooperative ecosystem.
roles_section.citizen_card_desc: Book verified household services, track arrival in real-time, and pay securely via digital escrow.
roles_section.worker_card_desc: Manage your work radius, receive fair rotational job dispatches, and receive daily 85% net payouts.
roles_section.cooperative_card_desc: Manage workforce rosters, approve new worker documents, monitor live radar, and settle welfare funds.
roles_section.institution_card_desc: Deploy bulk skilled teams, manage campus attendance logs, and streamline monthly GST invoices.
roles_section.admin_card_desc: Command center: oversee statewide GMV metrics, cooperative accreditations, dispute tribunal, and audit logs.
